sloka: अथ रामः कथामेतां भूय एव महायशाः ।कथयामास धर्मात्मा प्रजापतिसुतस्य वै ।। ७.८९.२ ॥
transliteration: atha rāmaḥ kathāmetāṁ bhūya eva mahāyaśāḥ ।kathayāmāsa dharmātmā prajāpatisutasya vai ।। 7.89.2 ॥

translations.english: Then, the greatly renowned and righteous-souled Rama indeed narrated this story again, concerning the son of Prajapati.
